title: Self-Pluralising Culture Alignment for Large Language Models
findings: The study found that 'Religious Values' was the topic that most frequently led to inconsistent outputs from LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct when prompted for different cultural perspectives. This indicates that religion is a significant area of cultural divergence within the model's knowledge. The proposed CultureSPA framework was shown to improve the model's alignment with diverse cultural values, including those related to religion.

measurement_description: Alignment with human survey responses from the World Values Survey on 13 cultural topics, one of which is 'Religious Values'. This topic includes questions about the importance of God and reliance on religious teachings for moral guidance.
